script.name: !lib.resupply.rearm.fromdockedat
script.description: dock at target and do tasks

line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.8.1: In the rare event that a ship without missiles has missile resupply set (due to vanilla's global missile resupply UI), we need to check here if they can equip that missile to begin with.
* Should never happen normally unless player used global missile resupply.
* miltrary outposts can always resupply max amounts
* works without DOCKEDAT for non-player-ships: spawns wares in cargobay
* this is better than have ships that don't have ammo and missiles
* v3: added special resupply for military outposts
* v5: (Cycrow) always resupply when at own station
